Since I met Deanna 11 years ago, I've been wanting to take her to Africa's most remote indigenous tribes, and we finally did! I hope you enjoy our adventure through beautiful Angola, Namibia, Ethiopia, Namibia and the D.R. Congo!
I wrote a book called JUST GO, with exclusive travel stories & tips to inspire your next adventures!
